scientific_integrity: Analytic proof from explicit finite Borel covering measure, independent boundary-point probability lower bound, and complex-linear non-equivalence; no external or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Disproves only the unique equality class in Rotem--Schejter--Slomka Conjecture 1.2; the upper bound for general complex convex bodies and the ordinary illumination conjecture remain open. No classification of other equality cases. Unindexed equivalent earlier argument remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Non-polydisc equality cases for complex fractional illumination in every dimension
